title: A bug's proof (contract bug-proof v1, Phase 3)
description: Whether a reproduction test fails on the ticket's expected result before any fix (D75, D76). Each attempt is kept with its hint, test, runs and outcome; the latest attempt is the current outcome. Stored in .stangent/tickets/<KEY>/bug-proof.json; the test itself goes into the repo's test project with the fix.

result.description: runner-error: the test runner itself failed before any test ran (D90), a setup problem.

outcome.description: reproduced: fails on the named assertion (the developer confirms it matches the reported actual result); not-reproduced: the test passes, or the attempt hit its cap; not-reproduced-flaky: a Playwright test that passed on one of its 3 runs; not-provable: no unit or Playwright test can reach it here; failed: no valid test after the one retry.

outside.description: Not provable because of a part outside the code (D83): skipped when every part is, or the reproducer's answer accepted without the retry.

advice.description: What the developer can do about a setup failure (D91), chosen by code; stangent never installs anything itself.

setupBlocked.description: Failed because of the setup, not the reproducer (D89–D91): Claude Code refused something stangent's own rules allow, the test runner couldn't run (a missing runtime or tool), or the app didn't build or start. See `advice`; the next run tries again.

commit.description: The commit the test ran on (with -dirty when the working tree had changes beyond the test).

targetSpec.description: The test target as it was, so --verify runs the same commands.

actualQuote.description: The ticket's actual result, word for word (D95).

shows.description: Reproduced attempts only: the words of the failure message that show it, as the reproducer gave them; code checked they are in the message and not in the test's source (D95).

baseline.description: Other tests in the target already failing at this commit: --verify allows only these.

confirmedBy.description: The developer who confirmed the failure matches the reported actual result.

verification.description: On the fix branch (stangent ticket prove --verify): the test passes and nothing else started failing (D18).
